summary: Operator's rates page (2026) confirms nightly 20/30-amp water-electric and 30-amp full hook-up sites, Campspot booking (deep link /book/chinookcampground) and a 2-night weekend minimum on all sites; amenities page confirms dump (departing campers), hot showers, laundry, store. Max rig 42 ft from the Campspot site types. Fees and season (read 2026-10-13) unchanged: the $30 low is Campspot's rustic single site for 2 adults, which Campspot offers to RVs to 42 ft. Seasonal share: Campspot sells 76 nightly RV sites (12 20-amp, 36 30-amp, 28 rustic) beside a seasonal section of 7 lot types, all full; the seasonal lot count is not published, so the share can't be computed, but the nightly side is large. Phone 231-834-7505 matches; note left as is.
